title.zh: Hyperliquid 与多家机构合作推进美国合规永续期货市场计划
title.en: Kraken parent Payward moves to enter US perpetuals market via Hyperliquid HIP-3

current_state.zh: Hyperliquid Strategies（纳斯达克代码：PURR），这家最大的公开HYPE国库公司，已申请美国期货佣金商注册，旨在为美国客户在Hyperliquid提议的HIP-3许可永续期货市场上提供服务。该公司报告季度净利润为6.206亿美元，主要由8.03亿美元的未实现HYPE收益驱动，其国库持有约3890万HYPE。
current_state.en: Hyperliquid Strategies (NASDAQ: PURR), the largest public HYPE treasury company, applied for US futures commission merchant registration to serve US clients on Hyperliquid's proposed HIP-3 permissioned perpetual futures markets, while reporting $620.6M in quarterly net income driven by $803M of unrealized HYPE gains and a treasury of roughly 38.9M HYPE.

updates.current_state_en: Hyperliquid in Talks With Kraken Parent for US Perps Market Entry
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
据 Bloomberg 报道，Hyperliquid 正与 Kraken 母公司 Payward 进行深入谈判，计划通过受 CFTC 监管的交易所和清算所 Bitnomial 向美国交易者提供其加密货币永续合约。据报道，Payward 已向 CFTC 提交了提案，但两家公司均未确认交易。

这将是 Hyperliquid 首次进军美国市场，并可能为其他离岸、未注册的永续合约平台在监管监督下进入美国提供模板。这也与美国监管机构将离岸永续期货交易拉回国内平台的努力相一致。

Hyperliquid 日交易额超过 40 亿美元，采用无需许可的设计且没有中心化运营商，这是其进入美国市场的核心障碍。通过 Bitnomial 路由将提供所需的受监管运营商和监督，任何协议仍需获得监管批准。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
Bloomberg reports that Hyperliquid is in advanced talks with Payward, Kraken's parent company, to give US traders access to its crypto perpetual futures through Bitnomial, a CFTC-regulated exchange and clearinghouse. Payward has reportedly presented a proposal to the CFTC, though neither company has confirmed a deal.

This would mark Hyperliquid's first push into the US market and could offer a template for other offshore, unregistered perp venues to enter the country under regulatory oversight. It also aligns with US regulators' efforts to pull offshore perpetual futures trading back onto domestic platforms.

Hyperliquid handles more than $4 billion in daily volume with a permissionless design and no central operator, the core obstacle to US entry. Routing through Bitnomial would provide the regulated operator and oversight required, and any agreement would still need regulatory sign-off.
updates.background_zh: Hyperliquid 是一个为去中心化永续合约和现货交易而构建的高性能 Layer-1 区块链，提供低费用和快速执行，且不托管用户资产。永续合约是一种衍生品合约，允许交易者在不持有底层资产的情况下押注加密货币价格。Bitnomial 是 Payward 拥有的美国受监管数字资产交易所和清算所。
updates.background_en: Hyperliquid is a high-performance layer-1 blockchain built for decentralized perpetual futures and spot trading, offering low fees and fast execution without custody. Perpetual futures are derivative contracts that let traders speculate on crypto prices without owning the underlying asset. Bitnomial is a US-regulated digital asset exchange and clearinghouse controlled by Payward.
updates.market_impact_zh: 如果最终达成协议，该交易将通过受 CFTC 监管的机构引导美国对加密货币永续合约的需求，可能将交易量从离岸交易所转移，并影响 Hyperliquid 的 HYPE 代币情绪。监管批准将是决定市场反应的关键变量。
updates.market_impact_en: If finalized, the deal would route US demand for crypto perpetual futures through a CFTC-regulated venue, potentially shifting volume from offshore exchanges and affecting sentiment for Hyperliquid's HYPE token. Regulatory approval is the key variable that would determine the market's response.

updates.title_zh: Kraken母公司Payward计划在Hyperliquid上为美国客户提供链上永续合约
updates.title_en: Kraken parent Payward plans onchain perpetuals for US clients on Hyperliquid - Cryptopolitan
updates.what_changed_zh:
Kraken的母公司Payward计划通过Hyperliquid平台向美国客户提供链上永续合约，目标是成为首家在Hyperliquid协议上部署市场的美国注册交易所。该计划依托Payward以5.5亿美元收购Bitnomial，后者将负责部署、管理、清算和结算这些拟议市场，而NinjaTrader Clearing将托管获批的客户账户。

这将是把完全持牌于CFTC的美国衍生品基础设施与去中心化链上交易场所连接起来的最早具体尝试之一，有望让美国投资者接触到此前主要通过离岸平台才可获得的永续合约。若顺利推进，这将表明受监管的美国交易所对链上市场结构的看法正在转变，并可能推动其他美国交易平台开发类似的混合型产品。

拟议市场被描述为“许可制”（permissioned），即访问权限受到限制，而非向任何Hyperliquid用户开放；其结构由Bitnomial负责部署与清算结算，NinjaTrader Clearing负责托管获批客户账户。Bitnomial的特殊之处在于其持有CFTC颁发的全部三项牌照，可运营完整的美国加密货币衍生品业务，这一资质来自Payward约5.5亿美元的收购交易。
updates.what_changed_en: Kraken parent Payward is reportedly planning to offer onchain perpetual futures to US clients through the Hyperliquid platform.

updates.background_zh: 永续合约是没有到期日的期货合约，通过定期支付资金费率来锚定现货价格，是加密货币中交易量最大的品种。Hyperliquid是一个运行在自主构建的Layer 1区块链上的去中心化永续合约交易所，其设计目标是在链上结算的同时提供接近中心化交易所的性能。自2022年美国本土平台在监管压力下退出该业务以来，美国散户基本被挡在加密永续合约之外，市场主要由离岸交易平台主导。
updates.background_en: Perpetual futures are futures contracts with no expiry date that are kept anchored to spot prices through periodic funding payments, and they are the most heavily traded instrument in crypto. Hyperliquid is a decentralized perpetuals exchange running on its own purpose-built Layer 1 blockchain, designed to offer performance closer to a centralized exchange while settling activity onchain. US retail traders have been largely shut out of crypto perpetuals since domestic platforms withdrew from the segment under regulatory pressure in 2022, leaving offshore venues to dominate the market.
updates.market_impact_zh: 最直接的传导渠道是围绕Hyperliquid及其HYPE代币的情绪与流动性：一家大型美国交易所将受监管的衍生品业务引入该协议，会提升市场对其交易量和手续费收入增长的预期，不过“许可制”设计限制了这部分活动有多少会真正进入公开的链上订单簿。更广泛地看，受监管的美国永续合约通道会影响到离岸衍生品交易场所的竞争地位以及链上交易基础设施的监管合法性，其中衍生品成交量和资金费率环境是最直接受影响的细分领域。
updates.market_impact_en: The clearest transmission channel is sentiment and liquidity around Hyperliquid and its HYPE token, since a major US exchange routing regulated derivatives activity onto the protocol would raise expectations of deeper volume and fee generation, though the permissioned design limits how much of that activity reaches the public onchain orderbook. More broadly, a licensed US route into perpetuals touches the competitive position of offshore derivatives venues and the regulatory legitimacy of onchain trading infrastructure, with derivatives volumes and funding conditions being the segments most directly affected.

updates.what_changed_zh: 洲际交易所计划与 Trade xyz 合作并入股，推出一个受美国监管的永续期货交易场所，运行于 Hyperliquid 基础设施之上，配备专门的清算和 KYC/AML 合规，覆盖股票、指数、大宗商品和外汇，尚待监管批准。

updates.background_zh: HIP-3（即“构建者部署永续合约”）是 Hyperliquid 的一项升级，于 2025 年 10 月 13 日在主网上线，允许独立运营者在 Hyperliquid 基础设施上无需许可地创建自己的永续合约市场。永续合约是没有到期日、跟踪标的资产价格的衍生品合约，据 DefiLlama 数据，Hyperliquid 是此类合约全球最大的去中心化交易所。据报道，美国总统特朗普曾在 8 月 19 日表示，CFTC 主席 Michael Selig 正在推动以“完全合规且合法的方式”将 Hyperliquid 引入美国。被列为 trade[XYZ] 投资人的亿万富翁投资者 Stanley Druckenmiller 表示“很高兴成为 trade(xyz) 的投资者”，ICE 也进行了战略投资。
updates.background_en: HIP-3, or "Builder-Deployed Perpetuals", is a Hyperliquid upgrade that went live on mainnet on October 13, 2025, allowing independent operators to permissionlessly launch their own perpetual futures markets on Hyperliquid's infrastructure. Perpetual futures are derivative contracts that track an asset's price without an expiration date, and Hyperliquid is the largest decentralized exchange for such instruments by DefiLlama data. According to the reporting, President Donald Trump said on Aug. 19 that CFTC Chair Michael Selig was working to bring Hyperliquid into the US in a "fully compliant and legal fashion." Billionaire investor Stanley Druckenmiller, listed as a trade[XYZ] investor, said he was "excited to be an investor in trade(xyz)", and ICE has made a strategic investment.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该消息直接影响了 Hyperliquid 原生代币 HYPE，其 24 小时内上涨约 20%，价格突破 96 美元，逼近 9 月创下的 97.96 美元历史高点，显示 HYPE 代币与 Hyperliquid 链上永续合约场所是市场对该消息最直接的敞口。由于该计划仍需监管批准且尚未上线，任何向美国受监管场所的推进都将通过监管与清算渠道传导，而非立竿见影的流动性变化。
updates.market_impact_en: The announcement moved Hyperliquid's native token HYPE, which rose about 20% over 24 hours to trade above $96, approaching September's all-time high of $97.96, reflecting how the HYPE token and Hyperliquid's onchain perps venue are the most direct market exposure to the news. Any shift toward a regulated US venue would transmit through the regulatory and clearing channel rather than through immediate liquidity changes, since the plan remains subject to approvals and no market is live.

updates.what_changed_zh: Trade.xyz 创始人公开确认获得 ICE 战略投资，并确认双方计划在获得 CFTC 批准后推出面向美国市场的 Hyperliquid 永续合约平台，覆盖加密资产并支持全天候交易。
updates.what_changed_en: Trade.xyz's founder publicly confirmed the strategic investment from ICE and confirmed the joint plan to launch a CFTC-approved US-facing perpetual futures platform on Hyperliquid, covering crypto assets with 24/7 trading.
updates.current_state_zh: Trade.xyz 创始人已确认获得 ICE 战略投资，双方计划在获得 CFTC 批准后推出面向美国市场的 Hyperliquid 永续合约平台，覆盖股票、指数、商品、外汇及加密资产，并支持全天候交易。
updates.current_state_en: Trade.xyz's founder has confirmed the strategic investment from ICE, and the parties plan to launch a CFTC-approved US-facing perpetual futures platform on Hyperliquid covering equities, indices, commodities, FX and crypto with 24/7 trading.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Trade.xyz's founder confirmed a strategic investment from Intercontinental Exchange and a joint plan to launch a CFTC-approved, US-facing perpetual futures platform on Hyperliquid spanning equities, indices, commodities, FX and crypto with round-the-clock trading.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Trade.xyz's founder confirmed a strategic investment from Intercontinental Exchange and a joint plan to launch a CFTC-approved, US-facing perpetual futures platform on Hyperliquid spanning equities, indices, commodities, FX and crypto with round-the-clock trading.

updates.title_zh: 【OKX 将与 ICE、Trade.xyz 的合作，计划将永续合约引入美国合规市场】
updates.title_en: 【OKX 将与 ICE、Trade.xyz 的合作，计划将永续合约引入美国合规市场】
updates.what_changed_zh: OKX CEO Star 表示，OKX 将协助把永续合约引入美国受监管市场，其结构为：ICE 运营一个新的美国交易与清算场所，提供覆盖股票、指数、大宗商品、外汇和加密货币的 24/7 永续合约；Trade.xyz 作为 ICE 的独家合作伙伴；由 ICE 与 OKX 的合资企业负责零售分销。
updates.what_changed_en: OKX CEO Star said OKX will help bring perpetual futures to the US regulated market through a structure in which ICE operates a new US trading and clearing venue for 24/7 perps across equities, indices, commodities, FX and crypto, Trade.xyz serves as ICE's exclusive partner, and an ICE-OKX joint venture handles retail distribution.
updates.current_state_zh: OKX CEO Star 表示，OKX 将协助把永续合约引入美国受监管市场，其结构为：ICE 运营一个新的美国交易与清算场所，提供覆盖股票、指数、大宗商品、外汇和加密货币的 24/7 永续合约；Trade.xyz 作为 ICE 的独家合作伙伴；由 ICE 与 OKX 的合资企业负责零售分销。

updates.detailed_summary_en: OKX CEO Star said OKX will help bring perpetual futures to the US regulated market through a structure in which ICE operates a new US trading and clearing venue for 24/7 perps across equities, indices, commodities, FX and crypto, Trade.xyz serves as ICE's exclusive partner, and an ICE-OKX joint venture handles retail distribution.

updates.title_zh: 纽交所母公司 ICE 推动将其永续期货引入美国，Hyperliquid 的 HYPE 大涨 13%
updates.title_en: Hyperliquid's HYPE Jumps 13% as NYSE Owner ICE Moves to Bring Its Perpetual Futures to the US
updates.what_changed_zh: ICE 与 Trade[XYZ] 签署最终协议，成为 Trade[XYZ] 受监管市场的独家运营方并进行战略投资；产品仍需监管批准且尚无上线日期。消息推动 HYPE 上涨约 13% 至约 91 美元。
updates.what_changed_en: ICE signed a definitive agreement to become the exclusive operator of Trade[XYZ]'s regulated markets and make a strategic investment; the product still needs regulatory approvals and has no launch date. The news pushed HYPE up about 13% to roughly $91.
updates.current_state_zh: ICE 已与 Trade[XYZ] 签署最终协议，作为独家运营方并战略投资该公司，计划通过 ICE-OKX 合资企业分销美国零售永续合约产品；该产品仍待监管批准，尚无上线日期。
updates.current_state_en: ICE has signed a definitive agreement to be the exclusive operator of Trade[XYZ]'s regulated markets and strategic investor, with US retail perpetual futures distribution planned through the ICE-OKX joint venture; the product remains pending regulatory approvals and has no launch date.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Intercontinental Exchange agreed to become the exclusive operator of Trade[XYZ]'s regulated markets and take a strategic stake in the firm, aiming to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the US pending regulatory approval, sending HYPE up roughly 13% to about $91.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Intercontinental Exchange agreed to become the exclusive operator of Trade[XYZ]'s regulated markets and take a strategic stake in the firm, aiming to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the US pending regulatory approval, sending HYPE up roughly 13% to about $91.

updates.title_zh: 纽交所母公司 ICE 瞄准美国 Hyperliquid 永续合约，HYPE 逼近历史高点
updates.title_en: HYPE teases all-time high as NYSE owner ICE eyes US Hyperliquid perps
updates.what_changed_zh: 纽约证券交易所母公司洲际交易所（ICE）与 Trade[XYZ] 宣布计划寻求监管批准，推出覆盖加密资产与传统资产的美国永续期货市场，消息推动 Hyperliquid 的 HYPE 上涨约 20%，逼近其 9 月创下的约 98 美元历史高点。
updates.what_changed_en: Intercontinental Exchange, owner of the NYSE, and Trade[XYZ] announced plans to seek regulatory approval for US perpetual futures markets covering crypto and traditional assets, sending Hyperliquid's HYPE up roughly 20% toward its September all-time high near $98.
updates.current_state_zh: 纽约证券交易所母公司洲际交易所（ICE）与 Trade[XYZ] 宣布计划寻求监管批准，推出覆盖加密资产与传统资产的美国永续期货市场，消息推动 Hyperliquid 的 HYPE 上涨约 20%，逼近其 9 月创下的约 98 美元历史高点。
updates.current_state_en: Intercontinental Exchange, owner of the NYSE, and Trade[XYZ] announced plans to seek regulatory approval for US perpetual futures markets covering crypto and traditional assets, sending Hyperliquid's HYPE up roughly 20% toward its September all-time high near $98.

updates.title_zh: ICE 转发 Trade[XYZ] 合作公告，强调“计划引入”一项
updates.title_en: ICE Reposts Trade[XYZ] Partnership Announcement, Emphasizing "Plans to Bring" an
updates.what_changed_zh: ICE 在删除早前帖子后重新发布与 Trade[XYZ] 的合作公告，并修改措辞，强调把基于 Hyperliquid 的永续合约引入美国仅是“计划”，且包括杠杆交易在内的业务仍需获得监管批准。
updates.what_changed_en: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement after deleting the earlier post, amending the wording to stress that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
updates.current_state_zh: ICE 与 Trade[XYZ] 重新发布经修改的合作公告，重申计划推出基于 Hyperliquid 的美国受监管永续期货市场，但强调该计划及杠杆交易均尚待监管批准，尚无获批或上线。
updates.current_state_en: ICE and Trade[XYZ] have reposted an amended partnership announcement reiterating plans for a US-regulated perpetual futures venue built on Hyperliquid, while stressing that the plan and leveraged trading remain subject to regulatory approvals; no approval or launch has occurred.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement with amended wording stressing that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement with amended wording stressing that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
updates.background_zh: ICE 是纽约证券交易所的母公司。Trade[XYZ] 在去中心化永续合约交易所 Hyperliquid 上运营市场；有关最初公告的报道称，这些市场在一年多时间里成交量已超过 6500 亿美元，且 ICE 作为合作的一部分入股 Trade.xyz。美国监管机构近年来在加密永续合约长期主要于离岸交易之后，开始为该产品建立明确的监管框架。
updates.background_en: ICE is the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange. Trade[XYZ] operates markets on Hyperliquid, the decentralized perpetual futures exchange; reporting on the original announcement said those markets surpassed $650 billion in volume in just over a year, and that ICE is taking a stake in Trade.xyz as part of the partnership. U.S. regulators have recently begun establishing an affirmative framework for crypto perpetual futures after years in which the product traded mainly offshore.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于基于 Hyperliquid 的永续合约能否进入美国市场：一个受监管、符合 KYC 要求的交易场所将把传统交易所运营商的基础设施与链上永续合约流动性连接起来，其中 HYPE 和 Hyperliquid 的订单流对审批进展的情绪最为敏感。有关最初公告的报道提到，随着交易者作出反应，HYPE 一度上涨超过 8%，而此次措辞的软化使监管时间表重新成为未定变量。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through U.S. market access for Hyperliquid-based perpetuals: a regulated, KYC-compliant venue would link a traditional exchange operator's infrastructure to on-chain perpetual liquidity, with HYPE and Hyperliquid's order flow most directly exposed to sentiment around the approvals. Reporting on the initial announcement noted HYPE rose more than 8% as traders reacted, and the softened wording reintroduces regulatory timing as an open variable.
